query:
SELECT 'planilha_ativos' as fonte, status, COUNT(*) as total, ROUND(SUM(CAST(valor AS DECIMAL(18,2))), 2) as valor
FROM cobranca_planilha WHERE ativo = true
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY total DESC;
